install:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin" "$HOME/.local/share/atlas-playwright" "$HOME/.local/share/atlas-geo-tools"
[ -f "$HOME/.local/share/atlas-playwright/node_modules/playwright-core/index.mjs" ] || npm install --prefix "$HOME/.local/share/atlas-playwright" --no-save --package-lock=false --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund playwright-core@1.62.1
[ -f "$HOME/.local/share/atlas-geo-tools/package.json" ] || printf '{"name":"atlas-geo-tools","private":true}\n' > "$HOME/.local/share/atlas-geo-tools/package.json"
([ -d "$HOME/.local/share/atlas-geo-tools/node_modules/topojson-server" ] && [ -d "$HOME/.local/share/atlas-geo-tools/node_modules/polylabel" ]) || npm install --prefix "$HOME/.local/share/atlas-geo-tools" --save-exact --package-lock=false --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund topojson-server@3.0.1 topojson-client@3.1.0 topojson-simplify@3.0.3 polylabel@2.0.1
if ! "$HOME/.local/share/atlas-venv/bin/python3" -c "import cv2, numpy, PIL, pyogrio, pyproj, shapely, svgpathtools" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  SYS_PY=$([ -x /usr/bin/python3 ] && echo /usr/bin/python3 || command -v python3)
  if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    uv venv --allow-existing --python "$SYS_PY" "$HOME/.local/share/atlas-venv"
    uv pip install --python "$HOME/.local/share/atlas-venv/bin/python" numpy Pillow shapely pyproj pyogrio svgpathtools opencv-python-headless
  else
    "$SYS_PY" -m venv "$HOME/.local/share/atlas-venv"
    "$HOME/.local/share/atlas-venv/bin/pip" install --no-input -q numpy Pillow shapely pyproj pyogrio svgpathtools opencv-python-headless
  fi
fi
touch "$HOME/.bashrc"
sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true
grep -qxF 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/share/atlas-venv/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/share/atlas-venv/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"
grep -qxF 'export ATLAS_PLAYWRIGHT_PATH="$HOME/.local/share/atlas-playwright/node_modules/playwright-core/index.mjs"' "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo 'export ATLAS_PLAYWRIGHT_PATH="$HOME/.local/share/atlas-playwright/node_modules/playwright-core/index.mjs"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"
if [ -x /usr/bin/google-chrome ]; then
  grep -qxF 'export ATLAS_CHROME_EXECUTABLE="/usr/bin/google-chrome"' "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo 'export ATLAS_CHROME_EXECUTABLE="/usr/bin/google-chrome"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"
elif [ -x /usr/bin/chromium ]; then
  grep -qxF 'export ATLAS_CHROME_EXECUTABLE="/usr/bin/chromium"' "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo 'export ATLAS_CHROME_EXECUTABLE="/usr/bin/chromium"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"
fi
grep -qxF 'export ATLAS_GEO_TOOLS_DIR="$HOME/.local/share/atlas-geo-tools"' "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo 'export ATLAS_GEO_TOOLS_DIR="$HOME/.local/share/atlas-geo-tools"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"
